com.vector.cfg.persistency.groovy.api

Interface IPersistencyModelImportApiEntryPoint


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IPersistencyModelImportApiEntryPoint
    {link IPersistencyModelImportApi is the entry point for the persistency module import API to import module configurations from a given file into the current ActiveEcuC.

    All method parameters and return values must be non-null unless documented otherwise.
